optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced quality engineer with three years of ownership over automated regression testing, defect triage, and release quality for a claims-handling application.
Demonstrated ability to design and maintain a nightly regression suite, propose test scope, and document release limitations and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Designed and maintained an automated regression suite (Java, Selenium, REST‑assured) covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, running nightly in the CI pipeline.
Reproduced and triaged defects from regression runs and claims operations acceptance sessions, recording steps, environment and root cause in the defect tracker.
Proposed regression scope for each release in test planning meetings; QA lead finalized scope and exit criteria, and quality sign‑off was given by the QA lead.
Wrote release test summaries for each release, listing known limitations (e.g., payment flows for reinsured claims not automated) and hand‑over notes for the support team.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Regression suite coverage map and one release test summary with pipeline run identifiers as verification trail (source: src_4d63cdf17c24).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience with automated regression suite design, defect triage, scope proposal, and release test summary writing. They do not establish ownership of the final quality sign‑off or setting of exit criteria, nor do they confirm production release gating.
